incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: service= inference-serving-prod (HIGH). No ack after 60s. Escalated to schedule=platform-oncall -> link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PABC1234
Alex Chen: @morgan can you confirm you didn't get that? looks like it went to platform rather than runtime.
Morgan Rivera: I didn't see the initial page. I just woke up to a duplicate escalation. I'm on runtime-night today. :eyes:
Sam Patel: we have customer reports of tail latency spikes around the same time (multiple regions). Not sure if it's real or noisy alerts.
Jia Park: quick check -> rotation-syncer created a duplicate binding between inference-serving-prod and platform-oncall during a schedule update at 02:14 UTC. That would route PD alerts to both schedules.
Oncall Rotation Bot: rotation-syncer: applied schedule update `night_ops_v2` -> bound service inference-serving-prod to schedules: [runtime-night, platform-oncall] (change id: rs-20260315-0814).
Alex Chen: ok that's the root cause. We have duplicate service bindings causing escalation chain mismatch. Mitigation plan: 1) silence platform-oncall for inference-serving-prod, 2) ack any noisy alerts, 3) reroute PD bindings -> single correct schedule, 4) run a PD test page.
Sam Patel: I'll silence the duplicate target now to stop the cascade.
Sam Patel: /pd silence add --service=platform-oncall --duration=30m --scope="inference-serving-prod"  # using pd-cli
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Silence created: id=sg-99877 (expires 30m).
Morgan Rivera: I'm going to ack any open alerts on runtime so we don't lose track.
Morgan Rivera: pd incidents list --service=inference-serving-prod --status=triggered  # found 3 alerts
Morgan Rivera: pd incident acknowledge PABC1234 PABC1235
Jia Park: I'm patching rotation-syncer to remove the accidental duplicate binding. Pushing hotfix to staging then prod.
Alex Chen: paste the quick fix here.
Jia Park: ```
# rotation-syncer patch
- if new_binding in current_bindings: skip
+ ensure unique_bindings before upsert
```
Sam Patel: after silence + ack, alerts are quieting. Customer telemetry still shows a few spikes, but fewer errors.
Morgan Rivera: reroute complete: removed platform-oncall binding for inference-serving-prod (change rs-20260315-0820). Validating failover path.
incident-bot: escalation summary: original alert -> inference-serving-prod -> duplicate bound to platform-oncall -> duplicated escalations to platform and runtime -> resolved after silence & unbind.
Alex Chen: action items: 1) Jia file a rollback-proof PR for rotation-syncer (assign: Jia), 2) Morgan run a PD routing audit for the last 24h (assign: Morgan), 3) Sam create a short incident summary for customers if needed (assign: Sam).
Jia Park: noted, creating PR now. Link will be in the incident ticket.
Sam Patel: I'll draft a short message for affected customers outlining symptoms and that we've unbound the duplicate route.
Morgan Rivera: adding a unit/regression test for rotation-syncer to prevent duplicate binds.
Alex Chen: timeline note: first page 3512345678 (02:13 UTC), duplicate binding applied 3512345660 (02:14 UTC), mitigation complete 3512345940 (02:29 UTC). Will open postmortem after we collect logs.
incident-bot: created incident ticket: INC-2026-0456 with summary "Duplicate PD binding caused escalation chain mismatch for inference-serving-prod". Assigned: Alex Chen.
Sam Patel: :thumbsup: good catch everyone. We'll follow up in the postmortem with PD routing hardening and an alert to detect dual bindings.
Morgan Rivera: one more: add an alert when rotation-syncer applies >1 binding for same service in one deploy. That would catch this earlier.
Alex Chen: agreed. I'll own that follow-up.
Jia Park: FYI logs show a failed previous unbind attempt that left a stale binding; adding idempotency checks now.
Sam Patel: closing thread for now, will update incident ticket when customer comms go out.
Morgan Rivera: thanks all.
